scripts.speaker: Shadow Blacksmith
scripts.text:
Now Basta is in charge of refinement for shadow items.
If you'd like to refine a shadow item, please visit him.

scripts.speaker: Shadow Blacksmith
scripts.text: Do you want to refine a shadow item? Pick yer poison!

scripts.speaker: Shadow Blacksmith
scripts.text: When a shadow item is refined, it gains extra bonuses very much like normal items.

scripts.speaker: Shadow Blacksmith
scripts.text:
Weapon: ATK, MATK + 1 increase for each +1 refine success.
Etc: HP + 10 increase for each +1 refine success.

scripts.speaker: Shadow Blacksmith
scripts.text: All types of Oridecon and Elunium can be used to refine shadow items. Each attempt will also cost 20,000 zeny.

scripts.speaker: Shadow Blacksmith
scripts.text: HD ores can be used for gear that is at least refine level +7 and will prevent breaking as long as you stay talking to me.

scripts.speaker: Shadow Blacksmith
scripts.text: There's nothing here!

scripts.text:

Choose your Ore and start refining.

scripts.text: HD Ore can only used for +7 or higher refine level items.
